preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 100 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(results) == n * (n - 1) // 2 for results in [line.split() for line in output_lines])
postconditions.description: Each test case output contains exactly n(n-1)/2 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(val in ['1', '-1', '0'] for val in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
all(all_scores_equal(n, results) for n, results in zip(test_cases, [line.split() for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the calculated scores for all n teams are equal.

postconditions.expression: all(min_ties_achieved(n, results) for n, results in zip(test_cases, [line.split() for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the number of ties (0s) is minimized among all valid configurations where all teams have equal scores.
